Quick, concrete ask as we close the month: finance needs a certified snapshot of committed $ and stage confirmations for all EMEA/APAC deals with forecasted closure in Nov–Dec. I attached the commit sheet (v3) — please do the following by COB Tuesday (9 Nov):
